fields.name: unused_head
fields.meaning: Not used by the game; stays zero
fields.evidence: always zero in every save image

fields.name: slots_copy_A
fields.meaning: Three game slots, 0x9A8 bytes each: slot n (0-2, shown as Data 1-3) at 0x0100 + n*0x9A8. Sub-rows give the record layout at copy A of slot 1; it repeats for every slot and copy
fields.evidence: writer c000:9ffc, scanner c000:99d9, loader c000:9bb0; verified save uses slot 1, second save uses slot 2 at 0x0AA8

fields.name: slots_copy_B
fields.meaning: Second identical copy of the three slots (slot n at 0x1DF8 + n*0x9A8); first fallback when copy A fails its check
fields.evidence: c000:9ffc writes it; repair c000:9e3e prefers it; byte-identical to copy A in real saves

fields.name: slots_copy_C
fields.meaning: Third identical copy of the three slots (slot n at 0x3AF0 + n*0x9A8); second fallback
fields.evidence: c000:9ffc writes it; repair c000:9e3e falls back to it

fields.name: slot.magic
fields.meaning: ME marks a used slot; anything else = empty slot
fields.evidence: c000:97c2 writes it, c000:9960 returns 2 without it

fields.name: slot.table_648
fields.meaning: Table copied from a ROM template at new game (work RAM 0x0648-0x06D3); identical in every save, purpose unknown
fields.evidence: c000:97d3 save copy, c000:01f6 new-game init from ROM

fields.name: slot.characters
fields.meaning: 20 character records of 30 bytes (work RAM 0x03F0). Record 0 = Marie, 1 = Elie
fields.evidence: c000:97e8; new-game loop c000:02fd uses stride 0x1E

fields.name: char.hp_max
fields.meaning: Current HP then maximum HP (Marie 119/119)
fields.evidence: repeats in all 20 records; HP/MP pairing matches MP screen value

fields.name: char.mp_max
fields.meaning: Current MP then maximum MP (Marie 179/179, matches the synthesis screen MP value)
fields.evidence: synthesis screen shows 179 MP

fields.name: char.exp
fields.meaning: Experience-like counter (Marie 1368)
fields.evidence: value scale; not exercised

fields.name: char.stats
fields.meaning: Attributes and unknown character values (18 bytes after exp); not split
fields.evidence: save bytes only

fields.name: char.carried_items
fields.meaning: Up to 4 carried item ids (index into the item table), 0xFF = empty slot. Giving Marie item 0x00 changed bytes +0x1B/+0x1C from 18,FF to 00,18
fields.evidence: diff before/after equipping an item (plus checksum only); ids match item table counts (0x00 = 5 held, 0x18 = 3, 0x6B = 10) shown on the equip screens

fields.name: slot.block_394
fields.meaning: Copy of work RAM 0x0394-0x03EF; all zero

fields.name: slot.block_6d4
fields.meaning: Copy of work RAM 0x06D4-0x06F7, cleared at new game; all zero

fields.name: slot.money
fields.meaning: Money (silver coins), 0..99999; 5000 at new game. Only changed through a routine that clamps it
fields.evidence: c000:9a98 slot screen reads it, c000:31a6 adds with clamp, c000:02c6 sets 5000; slot screen shows 5000

fields.name: slot.block_70c
fields.meaning: Rest of the money block; zero
fields.evidence: save bytes only

fields.name: slot.value_710
fields.meaning: Word set to 8128 (0x1FC0) at new game; purpose unknown

fields.name: slot.block_712
fields.meaning: Zero padding up to the accepted-request list
fields.evidence: save bytes only

fields.name: slot.accepted_requests
fields.meaning: Accepted requests: 4 entries of 8 bytes (work RAM 0x071E); an entry with type byte +2 = 0 is empty. Entry: +0 id, +2 type (0x34/0x15 by origin), +4 day counter counted down per day while in (-30, 200), +6 unknown
fields.evidence: c000:52e3 kinds 1/2/4/5/6 read this table; deadline countdown b000:e855; empty here (0 requests shown)

fields.name: slot.block_73e
fields.meaning: Copy of work RAM 0x073E-0x0791, set from a ROM template at new game; 15 bytes differ after the intro (progress counters, guessed)
fields.evidence: c000:9835, new-game init c000:0228; template vs played save

fields.name: slot.items
fields.meaning: Item table: 200 items x 6 bytes (work RAM 0x0792), indexed by item id. +0 knowledge flags 0-3, +1 count held, +2..+5 four property codes (0xFF = none)
fields.evidence: c000:9849; album merge c000:9da2 reads +0..+5; counts match the equip screens (item 0x00 = 5, 0x18 = 3, 0x6B = 10)

fields.name: slot.offers_a
fields.meaning: Offer list A: 5 entries of 8 bytes built by the game with random values (work RAM 0x0C42); +2 type tag 0x34, +4 day counter, +6 unknown
fields.evidence: fillers c000:37df/3717 write tag 0x34 with RNG e000:0f0c; filter c000:52e3 kind 0; 3 of 5 filled

fields.name: slot.offers_b
fields.meaning: Offer list B: 4 entries of 8 bytes (work RAM 0x0C6A); +2 type tag 0x15
fields.evidence: c000:3ac3/3af1 write tag 0x15 with RNG; filter c000:52e3 kind 3; 3 of 4 filled

fields.name: slot.mode_flags
fields.meaning: Game mode bit flags (work RAM 0x031A): bit 3 = slot screen in save mode (set while saving), bit 10 = extras menu available (recomputed from unlocks at boot)
fields.evidence: c000:952b branches on bit 3 (save vs load submenu); title c000:0819 sets/clears bit 10

fields.name: slot.event_flags
fields.meaning: 800 story/event flags: flag n = bit (n mod 8) of byte n/8. New game sets flags 16, 62, 66; flag 100 set during the opening
fields.evidence: set/test/clear c000:311c/3144/317c; new-game calls c000:0370-0380; bytes 2, 7, 8, 12 match exactly

fields.name: slot.table_26a
fields.meaning: 64-byte table at work RAM 0x026A (packed values; bytes 16-17 are 03 01, rest 0). Its tail overlaps daily byte counters used around RAM 0x28B
fields.evidence: nibble-masked writes c000:47aa; daily decrement loop c000:bb9f

fields.name: slot.money_snapshot
fields.meaning: Money minus its previous snapshot (period earnings); zero here
fields.evidence: c000:bb89 computes money[0x708] - [0x2AA] and stores it back

fields.name: slot.block_2ae
fields.meaning: Rest of the 0x02AA block; zero
fields.evidence: save bytes only

fields.name: slot.days_left
fields.meaning: Days left; counts down 1 per day from 1079 at new game. The calendar date is NOT stored: it is recomputed from 1079 minus this value (year = elapsed/360, month = (elapsed/30+1)%12, day = elapsed%30, all +1 shown)
fields.evidence: new game c000:02ea = 0x437, daily dec b000:e839, date calc c000:4e7a, slot screen c000:9a47; 1079 shows year 1 month 2 day 1

fields.name: slot.bitmask_35e
fields.meaning: Bit flags (work RAM 0x035E), 0x002F at new game; further bits ORed from a ROM table
fields.evidence: c000:02d2 init, c000:4086 ORs 1<<table value

fields.name: slot.request_count
fields.meaning: Number of accepted (non-empty) requests, computed while saving; shown on the slot screen
fields.evidence: c000:98ed stores list_entries(2); c000:9a91 shows it; 0 shown

fields.name: slot.flag_32e
fields.meaning: Word set to 0 or 1 by several routines (work RAM 0x032E); purpose unknown

fields.name: slot.checksum
fields.meaning: 8-bit wrapping sum of record bytes 0x000-0x9A5
fields.evidence: c000:992d writes it, c000:9960 checks it; recomputed and matched on every used slot copy in real saves

fields.name: slot.end_marker
fields.meaning: Constant 0x63 written after the checksum; never checked
fields.evidence: c000:9959 writes it; no reader compares it

fields.name: slot2_copy_A
fields.meaning: Slot 2 (Data 2), same layout; empty in the verified save, used by the second save
fields.evidence: second save fills it; only the equipped-item bytes differ vs slot 1

fields.name: slot3_copy_A
fields.meaning: Slot 3 (Data 3), same layout; empty
fields.evidence: zero in all saves

fields.name: last_slot
fields.meaning: Number of the slot last saved or loaded (0-2); the slot cursor starts there
fields.evidence: written by save c000:9b3c and load c000:9be3 from RAM 0x38E; read at boot; 0 then 1 across the two saves

fields.name: unused_gap
fields.meaning: Not used; zero
fields.evidence: zero in all saves

fields.name: global_copy_A
fields.meaning: Shared record not tied to a slot (live copy at work RAM 0xCA00): extras unlocks and the item album collected across all games. Written at events, not by the slot save
fields.evidence: updater c000:9d61, writer c000:a069, loader c000:a0b0; written during the intro before any slot save

fields.name: global.magic
fields.meaning: ME

fields.name: global.extras_flags
fields.meaning: 10 unlock bytes (1 = unlocked); the title menu gains its extras item when any of bytes +0x02-+0x08 is set
fields.evidence: kind-0 write c000:9d89; title count loop c000:0859 (7 bytes); all 0 here

fields.name: global.event_seen
fields.meaning: Seen bytes (1 = seen); byte +0x0C is set during the opening
fields.evidence: kind-1 write c000:9d96; intro diff sets +0x0C

fields.name: global.album_knowledge
fields.meaning: Per item (200): highest knowledge value ever reached
fields.evidence: kind-2 merge c000:9da2 keeps the max; all 0 here (album not yet merged)

fields.name: global.album_properties
fields.meaning: Per item (200): four ever-seen property codes; 0xFF = none
fields.evidence: kind-2 merge c000:9dc6 copies non-0xFF codes; fresh init fills 0xFF (c000:a22b)

fields.name: global.checksum
fields.meaning: 8-bit wrapping sum of global bytes 0x000-0x403
fields.evidence: c000:9e29 sums with len 0x404; recomputed and matched on every copy

fields.name: global.end_marker
fields.meaning: Constant 0x63
fields.evidence: u8

fields.name: global_copy_B
fields.meaning: Second identical copy of the global record
fields.evidence: c000:a088; identical in real saves

fields.name: global_copy_C
fields.meaning: Third identical copy of the global record
fields.evidence: c000:a09e; identical in real saves

fields.name: unused_tail
fields.meaning: Not used; zero
fields.evidence: zero in all saves

fields.name: internal_eeprom
fields.meaning: Console internal EEPROM: untouched by the game
fields.evidence: identical to a blank boot image in every save
